context:
display_timings[] is already the authoritative median-of-passing feed
used by every aggregate page (see getDisplayMs() and
BenchmarkIndex/PlatformIndex/Compare call sites). This item is a
straight data-source swap at ResultDetail.tsx lines 63/111/288 plus a
new drill-down section - not a new abstraction.
description:
Phase A of the Results Explorer strategy revision (plans/purring-jingling-petal-ultraplan).

`ResultDetail.tsx` is the only surface that currently violates the
"median at high level, samples on drill-down" contract: it renders the
raw per-sample `DetailResult.queries[]` array (every iter/stream) as
the default query table, while every other page (BenchmarkIndex,
PlatformIndex, Compare, Home) already reads the canonical median from
`DetailResult.display_timings[]`.

This item fixes that drift. The raw samples do not disappear - they
move behind an "Individual samples" expander so audit is still
possible without polluting the default view.

anti_patterns.instead: move it behind a <details> expander instead
anti_patterns.why: per-sample data is needed for audit/debugging
display_timings[] is already the precomputed median

preserves.behavior: QueryTimingChart visual output matches display_timings median values (matches what CLI reports)
Raw per-sample table remains reachable via the drill-down expander (no data removal)
fmtGeomean call sites on this page continue to consume detail.geomean_ms / display_geomean_ms unchanged
